description: Manage LinkedIn outreach campaigns and the outreach queue. Actions: - 'queue': Queue an outreach campaign with ad-hoc leads or a saved leadsListId (FIFO queue if another campaign is active). - 'get_queue': Inspect running campaign progress, rate limit cooldowns, queued campaigns, and extension liveness. - 'pause' / 'resume': Pause active outreach or resume a paused campaign. - 'archive' / 'cancel': Terminate outreach and move the campaign to History. - 'remove': Remove an upcoming campaign from the queue.

action.description: The campaign queue action to perform.

autoSaveLeadsList.description: Automatically save ad-hoc leads as a new lead list in Precept (for action 'queue', default true).

campaignId.description: Specific campaign ID to pause, resume, cancel/archive, or remove.

includePersonalizedNote.description: Whether to include a personalized message note with connection requests (for action 'queue').

leads.description: Array of leads to reach out to (for action 'queue'). Required if leadsListId is not provided.

linkedinUrl.description: LinkedIn profile URL of the lead

note.description: Custom personalized connection note specifically for this lead

leadsListId.description: ID of an existing Precept lead list to run outreach on (for action 'queue').

name.description: Descriptive name for the campaign (required when action is 'queue').

noteTemplate.description: Template for personalized connection note with variables {{firstName}}, {{company}}, {{title}} (for action 'queue').

name: precept_campaign_queue

outputSchema.description: Result of campaign queue operations (queuing, status, or queue lifecycle management)

activeCampaign.description: Actively running campaign progress and real-time statistics

autoSavedListId.description: ID of the newly created lead list saved in Precept

queuePosition.description: Position in the outreach queue (1 = next in line)

status.description: 'running' if started immediately, 'queued' if placed behind active campaign, 'paused', 'archived', etc.

title: Campaign Queue
